scene.ko: 고객사에 보낸 상자가 파손돼 도착했다는 소식을 팀장에게 보고하고 대처 방법을 정한다.

lines.en: Hi, Paul. Do you have a minute? There's a problem with the Corwell order.
lines.ko: 폴 팀장님, 잠깐 시간 되세요? 코웰 주문 건에 문제가 생겼어요.
alt: Paul, have you got a minute? We have an issue with the Corwell order.

lines.en: They just called. Ten of the boxes arrived damaged, and they need the products by Friday.
lines.ko: 방금 전화가 왔는데요. 상자 열 개가 파손된 채로 도착했고, 금요일까지 제품이 꼭 필요하대요.
alt: They called a few minutes ago. Ten boxes were damaged in delivery, and they need everything by Friday.

lines.en: That's not good. Do we know how it happened?
Not yet. They sent me some photos, and it looks like the boxes got wet.
lines.ko: 아직이요. 사진을 보내 줬는데, 상자가 젖은 것 같아요.
alt: Not yet. They sent photos, and it seems the boxes got wet.

lines.en: Okay. Do we have enough stock to send replacements?
Yes, I checked with the warehouse. Should I send them by express delivery?
lines.ko: 네, 창고에 확인해 봤어요. 빠른 배송으로 보낼까요?
alt: We do. I already checked with the warehouse. Shall I send them by express?

lines.en: Yes, please do. And contact the shipping company about the damage.
lines.ko: 네, 그렇게 해 줘요. 그리고 파손 건은 운송 회사에 연락해 주고요.

lines.en: Will do. I'll let you know once the new boxes are on their way.
lines.ko: 알겠습니다. 새 상자가 출발하면 바로 말씀드릴게요.
alt: Sure. I'll update you as soon as the new boxes have shipped.

expressions.note: 문제를 처음 알릴 때 · issue 도 많이 씀
